# ColorRun

A span of a [TextLabel](TextLabel.md)'s `content` drawn in a color of its
own.

## Parameters

- `start`: An integer. The run's first character, counting from 0 at the start of `content`. Defaults to `0`.
- `length`: An integer. How many characters the run covers. Defaults to `0`.
- `color`: An array of 3 floats. Linear-space RGB color of the covered characters. Defaults to `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]`.
